The data appears to be in comprehensive tabular formats in UN Statistical Yearbooks that require navigating through alphabetical country listings or downloading full CSV datasets to access the precise figures.

The threats species data is collected via the IUCN Red List and compiled by UN DESA into the UNdata portal. Each country has entries under categories like Vertebrates, Invertebrates, and Plants, with separate 2015 and 2020 columns.

Unfortunately, without being able to retrieve the actual numerical values for Denmark, Norway, and Sweden from these sources, I cannot determine which country had the largest numerical increase in threatened species from 2015 to 2020.
